name: 全包围深袋床笠式保护罩款
description: 白底主图开场，泼翻痛点、毛圈微距与卧室场景层层递进收口信任

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio fields alternating between clean white #FFFFFF, deep navy #1E4E79 diagonal panels and ice-blue #DCEBF3, with pale-blue bedroom walls and matte light-oak floors for lifestyle frames
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft front-left key with a bounce fill, cool neutral 5000-5600K in scenes, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: soft terry-loop textile surface with a neatly tucked elastic skirt, matte light-oak flooring and pale tile
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline and short sub-line only, always carried on blank placeholder plates
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside flat round discs, deep navy #1E4E79 on white, blank label slots under each disc
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle, consistent textile scale across the set, fitted corner detail always readable, nothing covering the skirt edge
noDrift: no printed brand artwork on packaging
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium home-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy #1E4E79, ice-mist blue #DCEBF3, clean white #FFFFFF and one warm orange accent #E4761B; cool neutral bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only on blank placeholder plates; thin single-weight line icons inside flat round discs; seamless studio backdrops alternating white, navy diagonal panels and ice blue, plus pale blue bedroom walls with matte light-oak floors in lifestyle frames; the textile always rendered as a soft loop-pile surface with a neatly tucked elastic skirt; stable product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用干净折叠成品 silhouette 抢第一眼点击，规避任何图内文字风险。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, folded stack standing upright at centre, full item visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, large soft front key with bounce fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace around the silhouette, clean even margin for thumbnail reading
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The folded textile stack standing upright at the centre of the frame, straight-on eye-level view, full item visible and never clipped by the edges. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a large soft front key and a bounce fill on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the stack. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace around the silhouette and a clean even margin. 8K commercial home-textile e-commerce quality. Negative: no text, no headline plates, no badge seals, no hang tag, no icons, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no pets, no gradient background, no floating stack without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.displayName: 斜切深蓝主视觉卖点图
shots.intent: 一秒把防护主张讲清楚：包装体块加泼水成珠加宠物同框，构成整套图的门面卖点。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle showing the front face and the top edge of the block
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with gentle fill, crisp narrow shadow beneath the block
shots.background: diagonal deep navy #1E4E79 panel meeting clean white #FFFFFF
shots.props: a relaxed dog lying on the upper corner, a pouring stream of clear water, one blank hang tag on a string, one empty circular seal frame, four blank round icon discs
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper-left navy field reserved for copy
shots.textZone: 左上深蓝区一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」与其下一行短句位「{selling_point_2}」，底部四枚空白圆盘标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The packaged textile block sits on the right half at a slight 3/4 angle against a diagonal deep navy #1E4E79 panel meeting clean white #FFFFFF; a generic relaxed dog lies on the upper corner of the textile while a thin stream of clear water pours onto the surface and forms a beaded pool with a small splash crown; a blank rectangular hang tag in warm orange accent #E4761B hangs on a string at the left edge, one empty circular seal frame sits at the lower right and one row of four blank round icon discs runs along the bottom band. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill and a crisp narrow shadow under the block. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space in the upper-left navy field carrying one headline placeholder reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and one short sub-line placeholder 「{selling_point_2}」 below it. Negative: no brand wordmark, no readable label copy, no size wording, no percentage figures, no filled seal artwork, no certification marks, no child or face in frame, no text besides the two bracketed placeholders, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用同机位两态对照放大日常泼翻焦虑，让买家把自己的床代入左栏。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at both mattress corners, matched framing
shots.lighting: left panel flat and slightly cooler, right panel refreshed soft key from the upper left
shots.background: pale textile field #F4F6F7 across both panels
shots.props: one knocked-over clear tumbler, a shallow pool of amber liquid
shots.whitespace: none between the two panels, a hairline divider only
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and camera. Left panel: a knocked-over clear tumbler on a bare mattress corner with amber liquid spreading and soaking into the exposed surface, flat slightly cooler light that reads heavier. Right panel: {product} fitted over the same corner, the same amber spill held in a clean beaded pool on top of the loop-pile surface with no soak-in, refreshed soft key light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at both corners. Background pale textile field #F4F6F7 across both panels, separated by one hairline divider. The product occupies 40-50% of each panel with no copy blocks between the panels. Negative: no brand marks, no before-and-after wording, no percentage or absolute claims, no dirt, mould or infestation imagery, no urine-stain close realism, no hands, no watermark, no fabricated results, no mismatched scale between panels.

Negative: no face, no extra or fused fingers, no distorted knuckles, no nail polish, no jewellery, no readable body text, no fabric sheen that looks plastic, no blurry subject, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 包装体块斜切深蓝版面，宠物与幼童同框、泼水成珠、吊牌、金色圆形印章与四枚圆形图标条；02 手压毛圈绒面特写加三枚细线图标；03 倒杯琥珀色液体泼在白色绒面上成珠未渗入；04 高 3/4 视角铺设完成的床体，三边虚线尺寸标注与四角箭头标记；05 新旧两款包装双栏 BEFORE/AFTER 对照，旧包装印有四口之家合影；06 女子把织物塞进滚筒洗衣机；07 成人与幼童在浅蓝卧室合力拉床笠、宠物狗在床尾；08 成人盘腿坐在铺好的床上与狗同框，右下角一枚环保纺织认证标。品类判定依据：全部八图主体为床笠式床垫保护罩，属床品，故 L1 取家具家纺、L2 取床品，与源类目提示一致，无需改判。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、四枚图标系列的自造名称、包装上的全部原文案与原句、尺寸标注的具体数值与尺码字样、金色质量印章与右下角认证标与星级类角标、原平台店铺字样、成人与幼童的可辨识面容（模板一律改写为背影或颈部以下裁切的泛化人物）、以及防水层结构与深袋深度的任何数字，全部换成空参数行、空表格单元、空白印章框与留空指示条。
